Our story

Family-owned, and still here after 35+ years

Toorak Dental Studio is a family-owned practice at 707 Malvern Rd, Toorak VIC 3142, established 35+ years ago. Longevity like that is not bought — it is earned one patient, one family, one generation at a time.

The practice covers cosmetic dentistry, implants, crowns and porcelain onlays, gum disease treatment, TMJ care and emergency same-day urgent care, alongside family dentistry for patients of every age.

Questions

Before you book

What is a same-day smile makeover?

A complete smile transformation planned and delivered in a single day, where clinically suitable. Your consult confirms whether it fits your case.

Porcelain or composite veneers — which is right for me?

Both are offered. Porcelain and composite differ in durability, finish and cost; your consult compares them for your teeth and budget.

I am anxious about dental treatment. Can you help?

Yes. Sleep and sedation dentistry are offered for anxious patients.

Do you treat jaw pain (TMJ)?

Yes — occlusal splints, orthodontics and bite rehabilitation. Payment plans are mentioned for TMJ treatment (terms apply).

Do you see emergencies?

Yes, emergency same-day urgent care is offered.

When are you open?

Monday 9am–6:30pm, Tuesday to Thursday 9am–5pm, Friday 9am–4pm.
